short_description: Ambuja Plus Cement, 50 kg bag. PPC with SPE technology for denser, leak-resistant slabs, foundations, masonry and plaster.
long_description:
## What it is

Ambuja Plus is a Portland Pozzolana Cement made with SPE — Special Performance Enhancer — technology, supplied in a 50 kg HDPE/PP laminated woven bag. The dry-process blend inter-grinds clinker with fly ash and gypsum, and the SPE route works by extracting the silicate gel present in the cement so the hardened matrix packs denser and lets less water through. It is a blended cement to IS 1489 (Part 1) and so carries no numeric strength grade.

## What it's for

Ambuja aims this bag at the whole house: foundation concrete, beams and columns, brick masonry, wall plastering and slab casting. Its distinctive pitch is roofing in heavy-rainfall regions — the denser, leak-resistant concrete is what the product is sold on, which makes it a sensible default for terraces, sunken slabs and other water-facing elements in coastal Andhra Pradesh. For ordinary residential work it fits concrete around M15 to M30 at a water–cement ratio near 0.45.

## Key specifications

The blend runs approximately 65% clinker, 31% fly ash and 4% gypsum. Expect around 25 MPa compressive strength at 3 days, 36 MPa at 7 days and 50 MPa at 28 days, with initial set at about 140 minutes and final set at about 215 minutes. Fineness is around 345 m²/kg Blaine, specific gravity about 2.9, bulk density about 1250 kg/m³ and standard consistency about 30%. Le Chatelier soundness expansion is about 1 mm and drying shrinkage about 0.06%. Chloride stays below 0.05% and SO₃ below 2.6%, with heat of hydration at 7 days around 235 kJ/kg.

## Application and installation notes

Mix the dry constituents until uniform, then add water gradually. The mix stays cohesive and shows reduced rebound loss in masonry, so less mortar is wasted off the wall. Place and compact within about 30 minutes, then cure with water for a full 14 days — pozzolanic strength arrives later than with OPC, and the leak resistance depends on that curing. Work between 5 °C and 40 °C. Stack no more than 10 bags high on wooden planks in a dry covered store, clear of external walls, and use within 3 months of packing.

## What's in the box

One 50 kg sealed bag, approximately 450 × 700 × 140 mm.
